en: A colorized panoramic view of a European city with a steep, forested hill dominating the left side, topped by buildings and a small chapel-like structure. Below and to the right stretches a dense cityscape of multi‑story buildings with red roofs, intersected by a river with bridges. In the foreground are fields and greenery. At the top center of the image there is printed red text that reads "Graz vom Rainerkogel."
